planning.assumed: Canonical OR group M-DIV-01(partitive sharing) OR M-DIV-02(quotition grouping); do not flatten to AND. Both meanings explicitly bridged. Full times-table fluency is strong support only. Remainder/multiplication identity is supplied; no written division algorithm required.
planning.scope: Core positive collections24,25,18,20 and selectable divisors2,3,4,5,6,10; optional last-digit explanation2/5/10. Bounded helper allows n0–40, positive supported divisors; zero is mathematically valid but not required in UI.
planning.interaction: Core checked remainder plus relation is a concept task. Optional manual packing model preserves same question and verdict; not mandatory tapping evidence. No false unqualified25:4=6 equation; use25=6·4+1. Optional divisibility rules explicitly explained, no exclusive category confusion.
planning.evidenceLimits: Provided quantities and bounded remainder/relation response do not show free proof, physical grouping/sharing, independent delayed mastery or personal progress.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Canonical roles/grade/groups/curriculum refs are frozen curriculum facts. Finite scenes, controls and lesson sequencing are original project design; external comparables corroborate concepts, not new normative graph facts or efficacy.
planning.feedbackSemantics: Root-owned input and change handlers each commit semantic edits; explicit check rereads visible task/answer. Edits clear dependent verdict. Separate help/model actions preserve the same still-valid practice verdict. No timers or persistence; pause/resume/reset/dispose clean3 scoped listeners.
